scripts.dev:emulated: firebase emulators:exec --config ../firebase.json --only auth,firestore --project demo-kip 'VITE_AUTH_EMULATOR=1 vite dev --port 3001 --strictPort'
scripts.lint: svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --fail-on-warnings && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.sw.json && biome check && tsc --noEmit -p ../functions
scripts.rules: firebase emulators:exec --config ../firebase.json --only firestore,auth --project demo-kip-rules 'bun test tests/rules.test.ts'
scripts.e2e:teardown: npm --prefix ../functions run export && firebase emulators:exec --config ../firebase.json --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-kip 'bun test e2e/teardown.test.ts'
